name: Buffalo Outdoor Center
description: NPS-authorized concessioner for the upper river at Ponca, running canoe trips and shuttles alongside cabins, the Ponca Creek and RiverWind lodges, the Dark Sky Resort RV park, a store and deli, and zipline tours.

name: Buffalo Camping & Canoeing
description: One of the oldest concessioners on the Buffalo, based at the Gilbert General Store. Canoes, kayaks and rafts with private shuttles, plus cabins, cottages and guest homes, and tent and RV camping within walking distance of the river.

name: Buffalo River Outfitters
description: NPS-authorized middle-river concessioner on US 65 at Silver Hill, offering rafts, kayaks and canoes with shuttle service, cabins, and a store.

name: Dirst Canoe Rental
description: NPS-authorized concessioner running day trips on the lower Buffalo, with log cabin lodging — the Elk, Fish and Bear cabins plus the Summer Lodge.

name: Silver Hill Float Service
description: NPS-authorized concessioner on US 65 at Silver Hill, renting canoes and kayaks with shuttle service on the lower river.

name: Riverview Motel & Canoe
description: Family-run NPS-authorized concessioner on the Little Buffalo in Jasper, offering one-day and multi-day canoe and kayak trips with shuttle service.
seasonal_notes: The motel is closed as of August 2026; the operator's site states canoe and kayak reservations are still being accepted.

name: Buffalo Point Concession
description: The park's own lodging at Buffalo Point: rustic cabins and a four-unit lodge built by the CCC around 1939, plus modern duplex cabins. Reservations open up to 18 months ahead.
seasonal_notes: Rustic CCC cabins run March 1 to November 22; the modern duplex cabins and the four-unit lodge are open year-round.

name: Buffalo River Float Service
description: NPS-authorized lower-river concessioner renting canoes, kayaks, rafts and tubes with shuttles, and running guided fishing trips and scenic tours.

name: Wild Bill's Outfitter
description: NPS-authorized lower-river concessioner renting canoes, kayaks, rafts and jon boats for trips from three hours to several days, with rustic cabins sleeping 2-10 and guided fishing on the Buffalo, Crooked Creek and the White.
